description: Refine the event's CURRENT cover with a short instruction ('make it warmer', 'swap the background', 'bigger title') — we re-render from the existing cover, keep the composition, and set the new one. There must already be a cover (generate_event_cover first). Counts against the monthly AI-image limit. Works on a live event you host (event_id) OR an unclaimed draft (draft_id + edit_token), so a draft's picture can be iterated before publishing. Needs a connected account.
name: refine_event_cover
title: Refine Event Cover
